metadata.case_name: CHEUNG BING KAI v. TSUI KAM HUNG

source: X-ray examination revealed that there was fracture dislocation of his left ankle and fracture of right clavicle.

He suffers from no rest pain at right shoulder with previous fracture clavicle but the fracture area is still tender on palpation. The range of movement of the right shoulder joint has become diminished than the left side.

injuries.description: Multiples abrasions on right elbow, right knee and left leg
injuries.body_part: right elbow; right knee; left leg
source: Multiples abrasions were found on his right elbow, right knee and left leg.

injuries.description: Fracture dislocation of left ankle (open wound, required debridement, open reduction and internal fixation)
source: X-ray examination revealed that there was fracture dislocation of his left ankle and fracture of right clavicle.
An emergency operation was performed for the left ankle injury, the open wound was debried, an open reduction and internal fixation were performed.
There is a 5 cm surgical scar over the medial mallelous on his left ankle. There is also another 14 cm scar across the front of the left ankle joint to the lateral mallelous.
injuries.icd_description: Multiple injuries of ankle or foot

manifestations.description: Persistent residual pain over his left ankle
Occasional numbness attack affecting the entire left leg occurs once to twice each week and each attack lasts for 15 to 20 minutes
Increasing pain on weight bearing and movement of the left ankle
Cannot stand for more than 30 minutes and cannot walk for 15 minutes continuously
Stiffness of the left ankle every time he starts moving it after rest
No rest pain at right shoulder but the fracture area is still tender on palpation
Range of movement of the right shoulder joint has become diminished
Pain over the right elbow on exertion
Frequent dizziness particularly when he gets up from a sitting position and before starting to walk
Walks with limping on left side and cannot squat down fully
Diminished light touch and pinprick sensation over the dorsum of his left foot
There is a 5 cm surgical scar over the medial mallelous on his left ankle and another 14 cm scar across the front of the left ankle joint to the lateral mallelous

treatments_received: An emergency operation was performed for the left ankle injury, the open wound was debried, an open reduction and internal fixation were performed.
Fracture of clavicle was treated conservatively.
Attended follow-up assessments in the out-patient clinic of Kwong Wah Hospital.
Regular out-patient physiotherapy at Tuen Mun Hospital.
On 7 June 1999, he had an operation at Kwong Wah Hospital to remove the metal implant from his left ankle.
He had to use wheelchair for six months and then a pair of crutches for a further six months.
He also received treatments from a bonesetter in Yuen Long.
